name: Nature Forest
description: A calming forest-inspired skin with earthy tones and natural colors
author: VirtualDeck Team
css: .sound-card { border-radius: 15px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-secondary), var(--bg-tertiary)); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px var(--shadow-color); } .sound-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px var(--shadow-hover); } .twitch-btn { background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-secondary)); border-radius: 8px; } .modal-content { border-radius: 15px; border: 2px solid var(--accent-primary); }
